% ADDED figure (2026-11-09): C8 Quantum Electrodynamics; generated by qft-C/tools/l18/figs/make_figs.sh
\tikzset{
  fdl/.style={line width=0.8pt, black},
  fdx/.style={circle, fill=black, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=3.6pt},
  fdv/.style={circle, fill=figB, draw=figB, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=5pt},
  fdlab/.style={font=\scriptsize, inner sep=2.6pt},
  fdmom/.style={->, >=Stealth, figO, line width=0.6pt},
}
\tikzset{
  fda/.style={fdl, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.55 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5pt]}}}},
  fdS/.style={font=\small},
}
\tikzset{
  fline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.56 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5.5pt, width=4.5pt]}}}},
  sline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, dash pattern=on 3.5pt off 2.2pt},
  blob/.style={draw, line width=0.8pt, fill=figB!12},
}
\tikzset{
  pline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, decorate, decoration={snake, amplitude=1.6pt, segment length=5.2pt}},
}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small, >=Stealth]
  \begin{scope}
    % spatial axes, photon along z (drawn to the right)
    \draw[gray!60, ->] (0,0)--(3.6,0) node[right, black] {$z$};
    \draw[gray!60, ->] (0,0)--(0,2.3) node[above, black] {$x$};
    \draw[gray!60, ->] (0,0)--(-1.35,-1.35) node[below left, black] {$y$};
    \draw[fdmom, line width=1pt] (0.2,-0.38)--(2.6,-0.38); \node[fdlab, below] at (1.4,-0.4) {$\mathbf p = |\mathbf p|\,\hat{\mathbf z}$};
    \draw[figB, line width=1.2pt, ->] (0,0)--(0,1.6); \node[figB, right] at (0.08,1.5) {$\vec\epsilon^{\,1}=(1,0,0)$};
    \draw[figB, line width=1.2pt, ->] (0,0)--(-0.95,-0.95); \node[figB, left] at (-1.0,-0.72) {$\vec\epsilon^{\,2}=(0,1,0)$};
    \draw[figR, line width=1.2pt, ->] (0,0)--(1.7,0); \node[figR, above] at (1.95,0.05) {$\vec\epsilon^{\,3}=\hat{\mathbf p}$};
    \node[fdS, align=center] at (1.0,-2.45) {(a) the spatial parts: two transverse ({\color{figB}physical}),\\ one longitudinal ({\color{figR}unphysical})};
  \end{scope}
  \begin{scope}[xshift=7.2cm, yshift=1.9cm]
    \node[anchor=north west, align=left] at (0,0) {%
      $\begin{array}{@{}llll@{}}
      r & \epsilon^{r\,\mu}\ (\mathbf p\parallel\hat{\mathbf z}) & \epsilon^r\!\cdot\epsilon^r & [\hat a^r,\hat a^{r\dagger}]\\[2pt] \hline\\[-8pt]
      {\color{figR}0\ \text{temporal}} & (1,0,0,0) & +1 & {\color{figR}-}\ \text{(``wrong'' sign)}\\[3pt]
      {\color{figB}1\ \text{transverse}} & (0,1,0,0) & -1 & +\\[3pt]
      {\color{figB}2\ \text{transverse}} & (0,0,1,0) & -1 & +\\[3pt]
      {\color{figR}3\ \text{longitudinal}} & (0,0,0,1) & -1 & +
      \end{array}$};
    \node[anchor=north west, align=left] at (0,-2.95) {$\epsilon^{0\,\mu}+\epsilon^{3\,\mu}=p^\mu/|\mathbf p|$: pure gauge, $F_{\mu\nu}=0$};
    \node[fdS, align=center] at (3.3,-4.35) {(b) four vectors for Lorentz invariance;\\ $3-1=2$ physical polarizations};
  \end{scope}
\end{tikzpicture}
